caption: Our test page from the Black Friday template went live on Landingi's test domain about 2 minutes and 20 actions after we started. The English template had Polish countdown labels; that spot is covered.
One test form entry led to this thank-you page, which says the discount code was sent. We did not check whether that email really arrived.
The entry was in Leads at once, and the trial banner counted 1 of 200 unique visits. That visit cap is the real trial limit; Build raises it to 2,000 a month. The account name is hidden.
Annual prices in euros on our Dutch account: Build 24, Optimize 109, Scale 209 and Enterprise 1,050 a month. Build allows 10 published pages and 1 custom domain; A/B testing starts on Optimize.
The payment step for Build: 288 euro a year, Pay now greyed out until the billing details are filled in, and no VAT line before that. We entered nothing and paid nothing.
